heading: EXT. HOT AIR BALLOON BASKET - 3,000 FEET - DAY

units.text: EXT. HOT AIR BALLOON BASKET - 3,000 FEET - DAY
Five bodies in a wicker basket built for three.
Clouds below.
One propane tank.
Zero grace.
We're fine, we're fine, it's just wind.
units.name: BARNABY CROOKE

units.text: It's not wind, Barnaby, it's your weight!
units.name: LUCINDA FAIRWEATHER

units.text: Who packed the sandwiches?
units.name: DEZ

units.text: We're descending. We are definitely descending.
units.name: HALVORSEN

units.text: We are not descending, we are...
units.name: BARNABY CROOKE

units.text: Hover! The word is hover!
units.name: LUCINDA FAIRWEATHER

units.text: Nobody touches the burner! I mean it!
units.name: PRIYA

units.text: I just asked about sandwiches!
units.name: DEZ

units.text: Priya, the altimeter is spinning.
units.name: HALVORSEN

units.text: It's supposed to spin!
units.name: PRIYA

units.text: It is not supposed to spin!
units.name: BARNABY CROOKE

units.text: Oh my God, there's a cow. There's a cow, and it's getting bigger.
units.name: LUCINDA FAIRWEATHER

units.text: That's not a cow, that's a barn.
units.name: DEZ

units.text: Everybody lean left!
units.name: HALVORSEN

units.text: Left is the other left!
units.name: PRIYA

units.text: I proposed to you at 3,000 feet, Lucinda, and you said yes!
units.name: BARNABY CROOKE

units.text: I said yes to a picnic!
units.name: LUCINDA FAIRWEATHER
